visual_blocks.heading: 1. What & Where (G.C. Leong)
visual_blocks.preview: 🔑 Trap: Equatorial climate is not a “summer-rainfall” climate like the monsoon; it has **rainfall all year round**.

visual_blocks.heading: 2. Temperature & Rainfall Rhythm
visual_blocks.preview: 🔑 Trap: Heavy rainfall does **not** create a large annual temperature range; the annual range is **very small**.

visual_blocks.heading: 3. Tropical Rainforest / Selva
visual_blocks.preview: 🔑 Trap: The hallmark of rainforest is **layered structure**, not uniform tree height.
